newsitem.title: RUSSIA: UES non-U.S. Trading GDR live - Bank of New York.
newsitem.headline: UES non-U.S. Trading GDR live - Bank of New York.

text.p: Russia's largest company UES has launched a global depositary receipt (GDR) covering Russian shares which may be traded outside the U.S., the Bank of New York told Reuters on Monday.

"A Regulation S GDR for UES is effective as of today, 12 of May," Bank of New York Vice President Mike McAuliffe said by phone from London. This regulation allows Securities and Exchange Commission-approved depositary agreements for receipts which do not meet some disclosure requirements and may not be listed in the U.S..
